name: Hidden Step Shoes
body:
Aura faint illusion; CL 4th; Slot feet Weight 1 lb.; Price 1,500 gp

DESCRIPTION

These simple shoes are dyed with black and grey colors and are surprisingly quiet to move in. The wearer of these shoes can move at full speed while using the Stealth skill without penalty. Once per day as an immediate action, the wearer can make all of his movement quieter, ignoring penalties to Stealth checks due to armor or encumbrance for 1 minute.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Item, silence; Cost 750 gp
